document: ET-8b gen1 heads — per-decision, the architecture FIXED at gen0
architecture_not_rechosen: gen0 applied docs/et8b-loop-gates.md §3 (shared vs per-decision, on held-out probe accuracy, before any loop run) and selected per-decision. This generation inherits that choice. Nothing here is selected on the held-out set.
held_out: task_id >= 226 — THE LOOP'S EVALUATION SET, and the loop must run only this
⚠️_why_the_split_is_stated_twice: gen0's chain fitted on task_id < 226 and ran the loop on all 300, so 225 of 300 evaluation tasks sat in the head's own training set. It printed +35.0 and the result is +17.3. The boundary is in the npz (train_task_max) so it travels.
how_to_read_the_controls: permuted must collapse to chance. If PCA-8 or the row subsample matches the full head, the signal needs neither dimensions nor examples and is a key being copied.
